content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to install [product_name] from the official portal, but I can't locate the download link for the complete version. So far, I've only found the upgrade to [version_no] and a demo, but I need the full version. If I have to purchase through the portal, is [article_no] the correct reference? It appears to be a physical disc to me. Thanks in advance
If you're not associated with a business, you won't be able to buy the DVD from [company_name]. [company_name] only sells to businesses. The reference [article_no] is correct.

That is just a demo, not the full version. Within the demo, you can create or modify programs, but you cannot connect to [product_name]. It's not possible to transfer a project between your PC and the hardware or access all functions needed for hardware interaction.
The usual approach is to buy the DVD ([article_no]) through a distributor, as most users do. Note: The demo for [product_name] cannot interact with the hardware, so this is not a complete solution.
I've already mentioned this information above! Please refer to my earlier replies.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are finding it difficult to obtain the complete version of [product_name] from the official portal, as only upgrades and demos are readily available. Buying the full version is restricted to business customers, making it challenging for individual users. The difference in functions between the demo and full version causes frustration for those who need to connect to hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily access or buy the full software online, regardless of business affiliation, and want all functions available, including connectivity with the hardware.
